name: +1 Power Per Punch
desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Strength Per Punch! ⚡

How to play:
👊 Every punch makes you stronger
🧱 Smash through walls that get progressively tougher
🧠 Face Brainrot bosses at each new stage (or avoid them!)
🔥 Gain strength fast and push past your limits
♻️ Reach the level cap and REBIRTH to unlock powerful multipliers

💥 REBIRTH SYSTEM: Strength resets, but progression becomes faster and stronger every run!
📈 Unlock huge multipliers and dominate future stages
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and prove your power

👍 Like the game if you’re having fun!
👥 Join the group for rewards & updates!

scripts.title: OP AUTO FARM
scripts.features:
🌟 Main Features
Auto Punch: Automatically trains your strength.

Auto Rebirth: Automatically resets to increase your multipliers.

Auto Win: Teleports and farms wins (100) automatically.

Anti-AFK: Prevents you from being kicked for inactivity.
